% Section 7 — Discussion and Conclusion (compressed)
% Full discussion paragraphs moved to Appendix B.

\paragraph{CF Severity.}
% exp_ids: phase2_scierc_full_s1 (CF=9.90%), phase2_scierc_grammar_only (CF=0.08%),
%          phase2_docred_full_s1 (CF=2.57%), llama_docred_full_s1 (CF=12.02%)
DR violations produce ontologically invalid triples that no downstream system can recover from.
CF violations are qualitatively milder: each triple remains type-valid per its own relation; only cross-triple consistency is broken.
The dominant pattern---\emph{Generic}$\leftrightarrow$\emph{OtherScientificTerm} (85/245 on SciERC; Table~\ref{tab:cf-distribution})---reflects genuine type-system ambiguity; conflicts involving \textsc{Generic} account for 63.3\% of all CF violations.
Ablation attributes CF to the semantic layer: grammar-only yields CF\,=\,0.08\% (matching unconstrained), while the full system reaches 9.90\% on SciERC and 2.57\% on DocRED (12.02\% for Llama), confirming that CF arises from per-relation independent enforcement (Appendix~\ref{app:discussion}).
% exp_ids: phase2_scierc_grammar_only, phase2_docred_full_s1, llama_docred_full_s1

\paragraph{Dataset-Dependent F1 Impact.}
% exp_ids: d012_bootstrap_ci (DocRED +0.50pp p<0.001, SciERC +0.13pp p=0.58),
%          phase0_docred_unconstrained (RV=29.66%), phase0_scierc_unconstrained (RV=1.39%)
The F1 divergence between DocRED ($+$0.50\,pp, $p < 0.001$) and SciERC ($+$0.13\,pp, $p = 0.58$) traces to grammar-layer OOV elimination: DocRED's 29.66\% baseline RV produces 5{,}189 false positives whose removal yields a significant precision gain; SciERC's 1.39\% RV (24 OOV predictions) is too low to produce a detectable effect.
Llama's lower RV (16.03\%) yields a proportionally smaller gain ($+$0.29\,pp), confirming that F1 improvement scales with baseline OOV rate.
% exp_ids: phase0_docred_unconstrained, phase0_scierc_unconstrained
% exp_ids: llama_docred_unconstrained (RV=16.03%), llama_docred_full_s1 (R-F1 delta=+0.29pp)

\paragraph{Contributions.}
% exp_ids: phase2_scierc_full_s1, phase2_docred_full_s1, llama_docred_full_s1
We presented OntoCoDec, compiling IE ontology schemas into token-level constraints that achieve 45--99\% DR reduction across two models $\times$ two datasets, with significant R-F1 gains on DocRED ($p \leq 0.013$).

% Limitations and Future Work moved to \section*{Limitations} in main.tex (ARR requirement)
